seg: You have always been there. He is young, he is a friend.
Let him rest, heaven blessed, bring him home, bring him home, bring him home.
He's like the sun I might have known, a bug I've grown to be a sun, the summers die one by one, how soon they fly on and on and I am old and will be gone.
Bring him peace, bring him joy, he's young, he's only a boy.
You can take, you can leave, let him be, let him leave.
If I die, let me die, let him live.
Bring him home, bring him home, bring him home.
